name: jong-hooks
description: Hooks that block risky shell commands and patches from a rule table the repository supplies: history rewrites, hook bypasses, merges in automation, path typos, and hand-rolled GitHub stacks.

interface.shortDescription: Block risky shell commands from rules a repository supplies.
interface.longDescription: Hooks that judge each shell command and apply_patch call against a rule table the repository supplies in .claude/jong-hooks.policy.mjs. A repository with no policy file is unaffected.
